title: Recombinant Expression and Purification of iBoost Vaccine Proteins in E. coli
author: Huijbers, van Beijnum, et al.
materials: The protein yield is low after Ni-agarose purification.
The protein does not elute with imidazole only.
Non-specific binding is observed in the ELISA.

steps.title: Prepare LB culture medium
steps.instruction: Weigh 10 g tryptone, 5 g yeast extract and 10 g NaCl into a 1 L glass bottle, add ddH₂O to 1 L, autoclave 20 min at 15 psi (1.05 kg cm⁻²) on the liquid cycle.

steps.title: Prepare TB tryptone‑yeast solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 12 g tryptone and 24 g yeast extract into a 1 L glass bottle, add 900 mL ddH₂O and 4 mL glycerol, stir until dissolved, autoclave 20 min at 15 psi, cool to ≤60 °C, then add 100 mL of 0.17 M KH₂PO₄ / 0.72 M K₂HPO₄ solution.

steps.title: Prepare 0.17 M KH₂PO₄ / 0.72 M K₂HPO₄ solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 2.31 g KH₂PO₄ and 12.54 g K₂HPO₄ into a 100 mL glass bottle, add 90 mL ddH₂O, dissolve, adjust volume to 100 mL with ddH₂O, autoclave 20 min at 15 psi.

steps.title: Prepare colloidal Coomassie stain
steps.instruction: Make 5 % (w/v) Serva Blue G solution by dissolving 2.5 g CBB G‑250 in 50 mL ddH₂O. In a 1 L glass bottle add 980 mL ddH₂O, then 11.7 mL 85 % phosphoric acid (add water first, then acid), add 100 g ammonium sulfate and dissolve, finally add 20 mL of the 5 % Serva Blue G solution and mix well. Work in a flow hood with gloves.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 M EDTA, pH 8.0
steps.instruction: Add 186.1 g disodium ethylenediamine‑tetraacetate·2H₂O to 800 mL water, stir vigorously, adjust pH to 8.0 with 2 M NaOH (EDTA dissolves as pH rises), dispense into aliquots, autoclave, store 15–25 °C up to 1 year.

steps.title: Prepare sonication/lysis buffer (DNase mix)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 60.06 g urea in ~400 mL ddH₂O, add 100 mL glycerol, add 100 µL of the 0.5 M EDTA solution, add 5 mL Triton X‑100, stir, then bring volume to 500 mL with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Prepare urea solutions in PBS
steps.instruction: For the desired concentration (e.g., 2 M), dissolve the calculated amount of urea (e.g., 120.12 g for 2 M) in ~800 mL PBS, stir until fully dissolved, then bring volume to 1 L with ddH₂O. Solutions up to 8 M can be prepared similarly.

steps.title: Prepare 5 M NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 292.20 g NaCl, dissolve in ~800 mL ddH₂O, bring volume to 1 L, autoclave, store 15–25 °C up to 1 year.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Tris, pH 8.0
steps.instruction: Weigh 12.11 g Tris base, dissolve in ~90 mL ddH₂O, adjust pH to 8.0 with concentrated HCl using a Pasteur pipette, bring volume to 100 mL with ddH₂O, autoclave, store 15–25 °C up to 1 year.

steps.title: Prepare 200 mM imidazole solution (10 mL)
steps.instruction: Weigh 136 mg imidazole into a 15 mL Falcon tube, add 0.2 mL 5 M NaCl, 2 mL 1 M Tris pH 8.0, and 7.7 mL ddH₂O. Optionally add 100 µL 0.1 M PMSF. Prepare fresh each use.

steps.title: Prepare Buffer E (elution buffer)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 13.8 g NaH₂PO₄·H₂O and 1.2 g Tris base in 950 mL ddH₂O, adjust pH to 4.5 with 1 M HCl, bring volume to 1 L, aliquot 15 mL, store at –20 °C up to 1 year.

steps.title: Prepare 10× PBS (1 L)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 85 g NaCl, 17 g Na₂HPO₄·2H₂O and 2.2 g NaH₂PO₄·H₂O in 800 mL ddH₂O, check and adjust pH if needed, bring volume to 1 L, autoclave 20 min at 15 psi, store 15–25 °C up to 1 year.

steps.title: Prepare 1 × PBS, 10 mM pH 6.7
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 mL 10× PBS with 900 mL ddH₂O to obtain 1 L of 0.1 M PBS, pH 6.7.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer for purification
steps.instruction: Mix 400 mL 1 × PBS, 100 mL 5 M NaCl, and 1.25 mL 20 % (v/v) Tween‑20 in a 500 mL glass bottle, stir on a magnetic stirrer until Tween‑20 dissolves. Do not exceed 0.05 % Tween‑20.

steps.title: Prepare 20 % Tween‑20 stock
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL Tween‑20 to 40 mL ddH₂O in a 50 mL tube, mix on a roller bench until dissolved, store 2–8 °C up to 1 year.

steps.title: Thaw bacterial lysate or pellet
steps.instruction: Thaw supernatant or pellet at 15–25 °C on the bench.

steps.title: Add Ni‑NTA agarose to supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL (for 10 mL supernatant) or 500 µL (for 10 mL supernatant) Ni‑NTA agarose beads to the supernatant (equivalent to 100 mL culture) in a 50 mL tube. Minimum usable volume is 200 µL (≈100 µL packed beads). Adjust bead amount if supernatant volume is larger.

steps.title: Incubate binding reaction
steps.instruction: Roll the tube on a roller bench at 2–8 °C for 3 h or overnight (~16 h). Optional: add 20 mM imidazole to reduce nonspecific binding.

steps.title: Collect beads and save supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin at 1500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, retain supernatant for a possible second purification.

steps.title: Wash beads with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Wash beads 5 × with 25 mL wash buffer (1 M NaCl, PBS, 0.05 % Tween‑20), spinning each wash at 800 × g for 3 min at 4 °C and discarding the flow‑through. Then wash once with 25 mL PBS, spin as above, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend beads for column loading
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 1–5 mL fresh PBS.

steps.title: Pack beads into syringe column
steps.instruction: Place a glass filter (Sartorius) at the bottom of a 1‑ or 2‑mL syringe, transfer the bead suspension into the syringe, allow beads to settle, and let liquid flow through. Do not let the column dry.

steps.title: Optional column pre‑wash
steps.instruction: Wash column with 4 column volumes of 20–40 mM imidazole to remove background binding (higher imidazole may elute target protein).

steps.title: Optional LPS removal with Triton X‑114
steps.instruction: One day before use, dissolve Triton X‑114 (0.1 % w/v) in PBS, store at 4 °C. Wash column with ≥20 column volumes of PBS/0.1 % Triton X‑114 at 2–8 °C, then wash with ≥5 column volumes of PBS at 2–8 °C before elution.

steps.title: Elute bound protein
steps.instruction: Collect 4 fractions of 150–250 µL (≈one column volume) using freshly prepared 200 mM imidazole solution (200 mM imidazole, 1 M NaCl, 200 mM Tris pH 8.0, 1 mM PMSF optional). If protein does not elute, repeat with Buffer E (100 mM NaH₂PO₄, 10 mM Tris, 8 M urea, pH 4.5) or 50–500 mM EDTA (note EDTA strips nickel and may affect downstream steps). Store eluted fractions at 2–8 °C overnight (~16 h) or freeze at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare vaccine emulsion
steps.instruction: For up to 10 mice, pipette the volumes listed in the Materials table into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, seal with parafilm, place on a Vortex Genie 2 with tube adapter, vortex at full speed for 30 min at 15–25 °C, then spin in a microcentrifuge ~20 s. Use the emulsion immediately (especially with Freund’s adjuvant) and inject 100 µL (containing 100 µg protein) per mouse.

steps.title: Prepare Rosetta‑gami/BL21 overnight culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 400 mL LB with the appropriate pET21a‑TRX transformed strain and grow overnight as described in the protein expression section.

steps.title: Harvest bacterial pellets
steps.instruction: Divide the overnight culture into four 50 mL tubes (≈100 mL per tube), centrifuge at 4000 g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant according to hazardous‑waste regulations.

steps.title: Wash bacterial pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 10 mL PBS, bring to 25 mL with PBS, centrifuge ≥4000 g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant; repeat wash two more times (total three washes).

steps.title: Resuspend pellets for lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend each washed pellet (from 100 mL culture) in 10 mL PBS.

steps.title: Lyse cells by sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate the suspension for 15 cycles of 20 s ‘on’ and 30 s ‘off’ at amplitude 22–26 µm using a Soniprep 150 MSE.

steps.title: Lyse cells by high‑pressure homogenization (optional)
steps.instruction: Process 200 mL of dissolved pellet through a homogenizer: three passes at 10 000 psi and one pass at 20 000 psi. Ensure at least 150 mL final volume for optimal recovery.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at ≥4000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, transfer the supernatant to a new 50 mL tube (this is the final Rosetta‑gami/BL21 extract). Store at –20 °C until use.
